rules: Volume register rules (all boolean, from V2_subsystem_volume_owner_register.yaml): volumes_may_overlap=false; null_geometry_may_be_filled_without_source=false; unassigned_mass_owner_may_enter_mass_total=false; selected_hardware_claim_allowed=false; cad_authoring_authorized=false (register itself does not authorize CAD; B3 human authorization is V2-UNK-017).

Any volume with mount_plane=null / service_direction=null must stay a placeholder: B3 may NOT invent mount planes, extraction directions, or hardware envelopes without a source (null_geometry_may_be_filled_without_source=false).

Mass ownership uniqueness: servicer mass = split bus 23.3032134 + 2x panel 0.3483933; the whole-satellite 24 kg row must NOT be added to the split representation; adapter plate+boss counted once under one owner; B601 counted only as accepted URDF exact 10-link sum (rounded YAML subtotal and other CAD material exports excluded).

All rows carry cad_mass_authority=false and dynamics_authority=false; B3 may only: write MASS_OWNER into custom properties, check no entity is double-counted by owners, preserve source_value/physical_status, and export CAD visual-only mass authority=false.

B3 forbidden (mass): overwrite the ownership table with CAD-recomputed values; assign default density to UNKNOWN placeholders; add target masses (22.0 / 150.0 kg) to servicer; double-count panel or adapter sub-geometry. SolidWorks default material/volume/'mass 0.00' may not fill CoM/inertia fields.

UNKNOWN_BLOCKED subsystem placeholders (OBC, EPS/PMAD, battery, RW/IMU, perception, propulsion, comm, thermal, harness) must have EMPTY mass values and stay out of the provisional total; perception reserve is zero-solid only.
Negative result DEPLOYED_REFERENCE_Q0_STATIC_INTERFERENCE (10 cases) must not be hidden or relabelled; global collision safety stays BLOCKED.

B3 build/review order (fixed, not manufacturing order): Master Skeleton -> Primary Structure -> bay decks/mount planes -> subsystem volume-owner placeholders -> harness references -> removable panels -> Robot Mount Module -> accepted B601 visual assembly -> solar interface references -> review overlays.

B3 minimum acceptance views: all exterior-panel candidate removal directions; middle-bay tray extraction direction; robot mount tool access; longitudinal harness corridor; solar root vs side-panel conflict check; keepout overlay under named configurations; any un-closeable access/interference kept as a negative result.

Serviceability directions carry NO tool size, fastening method, hand/arm reachability, or on-orbit maintenance assumptions; the plan proves review responsibility only, not real accessibility or collision-freedom.

Keepout ownership: rail/tab+insertion path, sensor optical, propulsion plume, antenna sweep/RF, thermal rejection surface are all UNKNOWN_BLOCKED (no geometry may be modeled as fact); B601 keepout is q0-only with global workspace unknown; solar swept zone is deployed-reference only; target approach/contact keepout is EXCLUDED; only mount tool access is DESIGN_PROPOSAL.
Mass total naming: only 'PROVISIONAL_DESIGN_LEDGER_TOTAL' allowed; never label as final/measured/V2-CAD/flight/dynamics-ready mass.

Caller must hold/record explicit human authorization (HAG-class) before any SolidWorks authoring; these files by themselves do not grant it.

CAD may model the sourced profile but must not claim standards compliance; V2-UNK-002 (CDS Appendix B manual review) and V2-UNK-003 (rail/tab + deployer interface) additionally block rail/tab keepout freeze and launch interface — matches the pending appendix_b_manual_dimension_review_todo.

MOUNT-PLANE GAP: only 3 of 12 volumes have mount planes (VOL-FM-ROBOT=M, VOL-SIDE-SOLAR-L=F_L, VOL-SIDE-SOLAR-R=F_R); all 9 others have mount_plane=null and mass_owner=UNASSIGNED — B3 can only create named zero-solid/reserve placeholders on bay decks, no hardware-shaped geometry (selected_hardware_claim_allowed=false, V2-UNK-014 blocks detailed_packaging).

VOL-FM-SENSOR and VOL-REAR-PROP are geometry_status UNKNOWN_BLOCKED (unlike the DESIGN_PROPOSAL volumes): even proposal-level solids are not sourced for them; consistent with V2-UNK-011 (camera T_SC/FOV — matches authorization boundary forbidding numeric camera FOV) and keepout table (sensor optical + plume UNKNOWN_BLOCKED).

MAINTENANCE-DIRECTION GAP: middle-bay equipment tray extraction direction is null/UNKNOWN_BLOCKED yet B3 acceptance views require showing a tray extraction direction — B3 must present it as a proposal/negative-result, not close it (agent_may_not_self_close_unknown=true); V2-UNK-015 (fasteners/latches/tool clearances/tray extraction) blocks serviceability_validation.
